svg.title: MRI: Magnetic resonance imaging
svg.desc: MRI (Magnetic resonance imaging), acquisition cost 1.0 units. Detailed images of brain structure. Regional volumes and thickness are measured with FreeSurfer. Incremental AUC over the cheap-only model at 12, 24 and 36 months: +0.054, +0.037, +0.039.
svg.text: AUC gain over the cheap-only model
